title: His Hand Is Not Too Short to Save
story: His Hand Is Not Too Short
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
The people called and called again
And thought He did not hear;
Their prayers went up like curls of smoke
That seemed to disappear.

[Chorus]
His hand is not too short to save,
His ear is never slow;
However far I wander off,
His reach is long, I know.

[Verse 2]
Isaiah spoke up plain and strong:
"It's you who turned away;
The wrong you did has come between
Like clouds across the day."

[Chorus]

[Verse 3]
When Beau knocked down a cup one day,
He hid where none could see;
Then out he walked, both small and brave:
He told them, "That was me."

[Chorus]

[Verse 4]
The cloud moves on, the sun comes through,
I turn around to see;
The Redeemer comes to Zion
And reaches out to me.

[Chorus]
mood: Coming-back music. A steady walking step in fingerpicked nylon guitar, like small feet stepping out from a hiding place: a little careful in the first verse, surer with every verse after. One warm low note on the first beat of each bar, like a hand on the shoulder. In the last verse the guitar climbs into higher, brighter open chords, like a cloud sliding off the sun.
